===== FILE: note/src/App.tsx =====
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AboutModal } from './components/AboutModal';
import { HeaderBar } from './components/HeaderBar';
import { NoteEditor } from './components/NoteEditor';
import { NoteListSidebar } from './components/NoteListSidebar';
import {
  ActiveSection,
  AppLang,
  EditorPrefs,
  NoteFolder,
  NoteItem,
} from './types';
import {
  createBlankNote,
  DEFAULT_PREFS,
  deleteNoteRecordForever,
  emptyTrashRecords,
  loadAllNotes,
  loadEditorPrefs,
  saveEditorPrefs,
  saveNoteRecord,
} from './utils/notesStore';

export default function App() {
  const [lang, setLang] = useState<AppLang>('fr');
  const [aboutOpen, setAboutOpen] = useState(false);

  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<NoteItem[]>([]);
  const [activeNoteId, setActiveNoteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mobileShowEditor, setMobileShowEditor] = useState(false);
  const [section, setSection] = useState<ActiveSection>('notes');
  const [folderFilter, setFolderFilter] = useState<NoteFolder>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<EditorPrefs>(DEFAULT_PREFS);
  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setPrefs(loadEditorPrefs());
    void loadAllNotes().then((loaded) => {
      setNotes(loaded);
      const firstActive = loaded.find((n) => n.deletedAt === null) ?? loaded[0] ?? null;
      if (firstActive) setActiveNoteId(firstActive.id);
    });
  }, []);

  const updatePrefs = useCallback((patch: Partial<EditorPrefs>) => {
    setPrefs((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev, ...patch };
      saveEditorPrefs(next);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const activeNote = notes.find((n) => n.id === activeNoteId) ?? null;

  const persistNote = useCallback(async (updated: NoteItem) => {
    setNotes((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.some((n) => n.id === updated.id);
      return exists ? prev.map((n) => (n.id === updated.id ? updated : n)) : [updated, ...prev];
    });
    await saveNoteRecord(updated);
    setIsDirty(false);
  }, []);

  // Auto-save debounce after typing
  const handleChangeNote = useCallback(
    (updated: NoteItem) => {
      setIsDirty(true);
      setNotes((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === updated.id ? updated : n)));
      void saveNoteRecord(updated).then(() => {
        setIsDirty(false);
      });
    },
    []
  );

  const handleSaveNow = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeNote) return;
    void persistNote({ ...activeNote, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  }, [activeNote, persistNote]);

  const handleCreateNote = useCallback(() => {
    const folder = folderFilter === 'all' ? 'personal' : folderFilter;
    const fresh = createBlankNote(folder);
    setSection('notes');
    setNotes((prev) => [fresh, ...prev]);
    setActiveNoteId(fresh.id);
    setMobileShowEditor(true);
    void saveNoteRecord(fresh);
  }, [folderFilter]);

  const handleDuplicateNote = useCallback((source: NoteItem) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const copy: NoteItem = {
      ...source,
      id: `note_${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      title: source.title ? `${source.title} (Copy)` : 'Copy',
      pinned: false,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      deletedAt: null,
    };
    setNotes((prev) => [copy, ...prev]);
    setActiveNoteId(copy.id);
    void saveNoteRecord(copy);
  }, []);

  const handleMoveToTrash = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      const target = notes.find((n) => n.id === id);
      if (!target) return;
      const trashed: NoteItem = {
        ...target,
        pinned: false,
        deletedAt: Date.now(),
      };
      setNotes((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? trashed : n)));
      void saveNoteRecord(trashed);

      const remaining = notes.find((n) => n.id !== id && n.deletedAt === null);
      setActiveNoteId(remaining ? remaining.id : null);
      setMobileShowEditor(false);
    },
    [notes]
  );

  const handleRestoreNote = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      const target = notes.find((n) => n.id === id);
      if (!target) return;
      const restored: NoteItem = {
        ...target,
        deletedAt: null,
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      };
      setNotes((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? restored : n)));
      void saveNoteRecord(restored);
    },
    [notes]
  );

  const handleDeleteForever = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      setNotes((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
      if (activeNoteId === id) {
        setActiveNoteId(null);
        setMobileShowEditor(false);
      }
      void deleteNoteRecordForever(id);
    },
    [activeNoteId]
  );

  const handleEmptyTrash = useCallback(() => {
    setNotes((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.deletedAt === null));
    if (activeNote && activeNote.deletedAt !== null) {
      setActiveNoteId(null);
      setMobileShowEditor(false);
    }
    void emptyTrashRecords();
  }, [activeNote]);

  const handleImportFiles = useCallback(async (fileList: FileList) => {
    const imported: NoteItem[] = [];
    for (const file of Array.from(fileList)) {
      const text = await file.text();
      const now = Date.now();
      const baseName = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
      const isCode = /\.(js|ts|json|html|css|xml|log|csv|md)$/i.test(file.name);
      const item: NoteItem = {
        id: `note_${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        title: baseName,
        content: text,
        folder: isCode ? 'code' : 'personal',
        pinned: false,
        isChecklist: false,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
        deletedAt: null,
      };
      imported.push(item);
      await saveNoteRecord(item);
    }
    if (imported.length > 0) {
      setSection('notes');
      setNotes((prev) => [...imported, ...prev]);
      setActiveNoteId(imported[0].id);
      setMobileShowEditor(true);
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col w-full h-[100dvh] bg-[#0a0a0a] text-zinc-100 overflow-hidden">
      <HeaderBar
        lang={lang}
        onChangeLang={setLang}
        onOpenAbout={() => setAboutOpen(true)}
      />

      <main className="flex flex-1 min-h-0 w-full overflow-hidden">
        {/* Sidebar: always visible on md+, full-screen on mobile when editor hidden */}
        <div
          className={`${
            mobileShowEditor ? 'hidden md:flex' : 'flex'
          } w-full md:w-80 lg:w-96 shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden`}
        >
          <NoteListSidebar
            lang={lang}
            notes={notes}
            activeNoteId={activeNoteId}
            section={section}
            folderFilter={folderFilter}
            searchQuery={searchQuery}
            layoutMode={prefs.layoutMode}
            sortMode={prefs.sortMode}
            onChangeSection={(sec) => {
              setSection(sec);
              const first = notes.find((n) =>
                sec === 'trash' ? n.deletedAt !== null : n.deletedAt === null
              );
              setActiveNoteId(first ? first.id : null);
            }}
            onChangeFolderFilter={setFolderFilter}
            onChangeSearch={setSearchQuery}
            onChangeLayoutMode={(m) => updatePrefs({ layoutMode: m })}
            onChangeSortMode={(s) => updatePrefs({ sortMode: s })}
            onSelectNote={(id) => {
              setActiveNoteId(id);
              setMobileShowEditor(true);
            }}
            onCreateNote={handleCreateNote}
            onRestoreNote={handleRestoreNote}
            onDeleteForever={handleDeleteForever}
            onEmptyTrash={handleEmptyTrash}
            onImportFiles={(files) => void handleImportFiles(files)}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Editor Pane: visible on md+, full-screen on mobile when note selected */}
        <div
          className={`${
            mobileShowEditor ? 'flex' : 'hidden md:flex'
          } flex-1 min-w-0 h-full overflow-hidden`}
        >
          <NoteEditor
            lang={lang}
            note={activeNote}
            prefs={prefs}
            isDirty={isDirty}
            onUpdatePrefs={updatePrefs}
            onChangeNote={handleChangeNote}
            onSaveNow={handleSaveNow}
            onMoveToTrash={handleMoveToTrash}
            onRestoreNote={handleRestoreNote}
            onDeleteForever={handleDeleteForever}
            onDuplicateNote={handleDuplicateNote}
            onBackMobile={() => setMobileShowEditor(false)}
            onCreateNew={handleCreateNote}
          />
        </div>
      </main>

      <AboutModal open={aboutOpen} lang={lang} onClose={() => setAboutOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: note/src/types.ts =====
export type AppLang = 'fr' | 'ar' | 'en';

export type NoteFolder = 'all' | 'personal' | 'work' | 'ideas' | 'code';

export type EditorFontFamily = 'sans' | 'serif' | 'mono';

export type ViewLayoutMode = 'list' | 'grid';

export type ActiveSection = 'notes' | 'trash';

export type SortMode = 'updated' | 'created' | 'title';

export interface NoteItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  folder: Exclude<NoteFolder, 'all'>;
  pinned: boolean;
  isChecklist: boolean;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
  deletedAt: number | null;
}

export interface EditorPrefs {
  wordWrap: boolean;
  showLineNumbers: boolean;
  fontFamily: EditorFontFamily;
  fontSize: number;
  layoutMode: ViewLayoutMode;
  sortMode: SortMode;
}

===== FILE: note/src/components/HeaderBar.tsx =====
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Download, Info, PenLine } from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLang } from '../types';
import { tLabel } from '../utils/i18n';
import { usePWAInstall } from '../utils/usePWAInstall';

interface HeaderBarProps {
  lang: AppLang;
  onChangeLang: (lang: AppLang) => void;
  onOpenAbout: () => void;
}

export const HeaderBar: React.FC<HeaderBarProps> = ({
  lang,
  onChangeLang,
  onOpenAbout,
}) => {
  const t = tLabel(lang);
  const { isInstallable, isInstalled, isIOS, install } = usePWAInstall();
  const [iosGuideOpen, setIosGuideOpen] = useState(false);
  const langs: AppLang[] = ['fr', 'ar', 'en'];

  return (
    <>
      <header className="relative z-30 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 h-14 bg-[#0a0a0a] border-b border-[#d4af37]/20 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#141417] border border-[#d4af37]/40 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <PenLine className="w-4 h-4 text-[#f4e095]" />
          </div>
          <span className="text-base font-extrabold tracking-tight text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-[#f7e7a9] via-[#d4af37] to-[#b58924] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 font-display">
            {t.appTitle}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center bg-[#141417] border border-[#d4af37]/20 rounded-lg p-0.5">
            {langs.map((code) => (
              <button
                key={code}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onChangeLang(code)}
                className={`px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase rounded-md transition whitespace-nowrap ${
                  lang === code
                    ? 'bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a]'
                    : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#f4e095]'
                }`}
              >
                {code}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {!isInstalled && isInstallable && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void install()}
              className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a] text-xs font-extrabold hover:brightness-110 transition whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              {t.installApp}
            </button>
          )}

          {!isInstalled && !isInstallable && isIOS && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIosGuideOpen(true)}
              className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141417] border border-[#d4af37]/35 text-[#f4e095] text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              {t.installApp}
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenAbout}
            aria-label="About"
            className="min-w-[38px] min-h-[38px] rounded-lg bg-[#141417] border border-[#d4af37]/25 text-[#d4af37] hover:bg-[#1c1c21] flex items-center justify-center transition"
          >
            <Info className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {iosGuideOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/75 p-4">
          <div className="w-full max-w-xs rounded-2xl bg-[#111115] border border-[#d4af37]/35 p-5 space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#f4e095]">{t.installApp} (iOS)</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed">
              Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIosGuideOpen(false)}
              className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a] font-bold text-xs"
            >
              {t.close}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

===== FILE: note/src/components/AboutModal.tsx =====
import React from 'react';
import { MapPin, ShieldCheck, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLang } from '../types';
import { tLabel } from '../utils/i18n';

interface AboutModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  lang: AppLang;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const AboutModal: React.FC<AboutModalProps> = ({ open, lang, onClose }) => {
  if (!open) return null;
  const t = tLabel(lang);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div
        dir={lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
        className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-[#111114] border border-[#d4af37]/40 p-5 shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)]"
      >
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <img
              src="/icon.svg"
              alt="Notes Gold"
              className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl border border-[#d4af37]/40"
            />
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#f4e095]">{t.aboutTitle}</h2>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#d4af37]">{t.aboutCreatedBy}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1a1a1f] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#17171b] border border-[#d4af37]/20">
            <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37] shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-100">{t.aboutCity}</span>
          </div>

          <p className="text-zinc-300">{t.aboutDesc}</p>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#0c0c0e] border border-zinc-800 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#d4af37]" />
              Package ID
            </span>
            <span className="text-[#f4e095]">com.aymengharsalli.notes</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="mt-5 w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#f4e095] via-[#d4af37] to-[#b58924] text-[#0a0a0a] font-extrabold text-sm hover:brightness-110 transition"
        >
          {t.close}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

===== FILE: note/src/components/NoteListSidebar.tsx =====
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import {
  FileText,
  FolderOpen,
  LayoutGrid,
  List,
  Pin,
  Plus,
  RotateCcw,
  Search,
  Trash2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  ActiveSection,
  AppLang,
  NoteFolder,
  NoteItem,
  SortMode,
  ViewLayoutMode,
} from '../types';
import { tLabel } from '../utils/i18n';

interface NoteListSidebarProps {
  lang: AppLang;
  notes: NoteItem[];
  activeNoteId: string | null;
  section: ActiveSection;
  folderFilter: NoteFolder;
  searchQuery: string;
  layoutMode: ViewLayoutMode;
  sortMode: SortMode;
  onChangeSection: (sec: ActiveSection) => void;
  onChangeFolderFilter: (f: NoteFolder) => void;
  onChangeSearch: (q: string) => void;
  onChangeLayoutMode: (m: ViewLayoutMode) => void;
  onChangeSortMode: (s: SortMode) => void;
  onSelectNote: (id: string) => void;
  onCreateNote: () => void;
  onRestoreNote: (id: string) => void;
  onDeleteForever: (id: string) => void;
  onEmptyTrash: () => void;
  onImportFiles: (files: FileList) => void;
}

export const NoteListSidebar: React.FC<NoteListSidebarProps> = ({
  lang,
  notes,
  activeNoteId,
  section,
  folderFilter,
  searchQuery,
  layoutMode,
  sortMode,
  onChangeSection,
  onChangeFolderFilter,
  onChangeSearch,
  onChangeLayoutMode,
  onChangeSortMode,
  onSelectNote,
  onCreateNote,
  onRestoreNote,
  onDeleteForever,
  onEmptyTrash,
  onImportFiles,
}) => {
  const t = tLabel(lang);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  const activeCount = notes.filter((n) => n.deletedAt === null).length;
  const trashCount = notes.filter((n) => n.deletedAt !== null).length;

  const folders: Array<{ id: NoteFolder; label: string }> = [
    { id: 'all', label: t.folderAll },
    { id: 'personal', label: t.folderPersonal },
    { id: 'work', label: t.folderWork },
    { id: 'ideas', label: t.folderIdeas },
    { id: 'code', label: t.folderCode },
  ];

  const folderLabelMap: Record<Exclude<NoteFolder, 'all'>, string> = {
    personal: t.folderPersonal,
    work: t.folderWork,
    ideas: t.folderIdeas,
    code: t.folderCode,
  };

  const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
  const visibleNotes = notes
    .filter((n) => (section === 'trash' ? n.deletedAt !== null : n.deletedAt === null))
    .filter((n) =>
      section === 'notes' && folderFilter !== 'all' ? n.folder === folderFilter : true
    )
    .filter((n) =>
      q
        ? n.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || n.content.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        : true
    )
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (section === 'notes' && a.pinned !== b.pinned) {
        return a.pinned ? -1 : 1;
      }
      if (sortMode === 'title') {
        return (a.title || 'Untitled').localeCompare(b.title || 'Untitled');
      }
      if (sortMode === 'created') {
        return b.createdAt - a.createdAt;
      }
      return b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt;
    });

  const formatDate = (ts: number) => {
    try {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === 'ar' ? 'ar-TN' : lang === 'fr' ? 'fr-TN' : 'en-GB', {
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      }).format(new Date(ts));
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <aside
      dir={lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
      className="flex flex-col w-full h-full bg-[#0d0d10] border-r border-[#d4af37]/20 overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Top Section Switch (Notes vs Trash) + Quick Actions */}
      <div className="p-3 space-y-2.5 border-b border-zinc-800/80 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center flex-1 bg-[#141418] border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onChangeSection('notes')}
              className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap ${
                section === 'notes'
                  ? 'bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a]'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#f4e095]'
              }`}
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{t.allNotes}</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] opacity-80">({activeCount})</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onChangeSection('trash')}
              className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap ${
                section === 'trash'
                  ? 'bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a]'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#f4e095]'
              }`}
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{t.trashBin}</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] opacity-80">({trashCount})</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            multiple
            accept=".txt,.md,.json,.csv,.log,.js,.ts,.html,.css,.xml"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={(e) => {
              if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
                onImportFiles(e.target.files);
                e.target.value = '';
              }
            }}
          />

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            title={t.openFile}
            className="min-w-[40px] min-h-[40px] rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#d4af37]/25 text-[#d4af37] hover:bg-[#1b1b21] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
          >
            <FolderOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Search + View Toggle + Sort */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-zinc-800 focus-within:border-[#d4af37]/50">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37] shrink-0" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => onChangeSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t.searchPlaceholder}
              className="w-full bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus:outline-none"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onChangeSearch('')}
                className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onChangeLayoutMode(layoutMode === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list')}
            aria-label="Toggle layout"
            className="min-w-[38px] min-h-[38px] rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-zinc-800 text-[#f4e095] flex items-center justify-center hover:border-[#d4af37]/40 shrink-0"
          >
            {layoutMode === 'list' ? (
              <LayoutGrid className="w-4 h-4" />
            ) : (
              <List className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Folder Filters & Sort Row */}
        {section === 'notes' ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-0.5">
              {folders.map((f) => (
                <button
                  key={f.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onChangeFolderFilter(f.id)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition ${
                    folderFilter === f.id
                      ? 'bg-[#d4af37]/20 text-[#f4e095] border border-[#d4af37]/45'
                      : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 border border-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  {f.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <select
              value={sortMode}
              onChange={(e) => onChangeSortMode(e.target.value as SortMode)}
              className="bg-[#141418] border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#d4af37]/40 shrink-0"
            >
              <option value="updated">{t.sortUpdated}</option>
              <option value="created">{t.sortCreated}</option>
              <option value="title">{t.sortTitle}</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        ) : (
          trashCount > 0 && (
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onEmptyTrash}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-500/15 border border-red-500/35 text-red-300 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-red-500/25 transition"
              >
                {t.emptyTrashBtn}
              </button>
            </div>
          )
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Notes Grid or List */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3">
        {visibleNotes.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-6 py-12">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#d4af37]/25 flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
              {section === 'trash' ? (
                <Trash2 className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-500" />
              ) : (
                <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-[#d4af37]" />
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200">
              {section === 'trash' ? t.trashEmptyTitle : t.emptyStateTitle}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-1 max-w-xs">
              {section === 'trash' ? t.trashEmptyDesc : t.emptyStateDesc}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div
            className={
              layoutMode === 'grid'
                ? 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5'
                : 'space-y-2'
            }
          >
            {visibleNotes.map((note) => {
              const selected = note.id === activeNoteId;
              const preview =
                note.content.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 110) ||
                t.contentPlaceholder;
              return (
                <div
                  key={note.id}
                  onClick={() => onSelectNote(note.id)}
                  role="button"
                  tabIndex={0}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') onSelectNote(note.id);
                  }}
                  className={`group rounded-2xl p-3.5 cursor-pointer transition border ${
                    selected
                      ? 'bg-[#17171c] border-[#d4af37]/55'
                      : 'bg-[#121216] border-zinc-800/80 hover:border-[#d4af37]/30'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-100 truncate">
                      {note.title.trim() || preview.slice(0, 28)}
                    </h3>
                    {note.pinned && section === 'notes' && (
                      <Pin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#d4af37] shrink-0 fill-[#d4af37]" />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1.5 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                    {preview}
                  </p>

                  {/* Clean unboxed metadata row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mt-2.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 font-mono-num">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
                      <span>{folderLabelMap[note.folder]}</span>
                      <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                      <span>{formatDate(note.updatedAt)}</span>
                    </div>

                    {section === 'trash' && (
                      <div
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0"
                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                      >
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onRestoreNote(note.id)}
                          title={t.restore}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37]/15 text-[#f4e095] hover:bg-[#d4af37]/30"
                        >
                          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onDeleteForever(note.id)}
                          title={t.deleteForever}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-500/15 text-red-300 hover:bg-red-500/30"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Sticky Thumb Action Bar */}
      {section === 'notes' && (
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-zinc-800/80 bg-[#0d0d10] shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onCreateNote}
            className="w-full min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#f4e095] via-[#d4af37] to-[#b58924] text-[#0a0a0a] font-extrabold text-sm hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.99] transition"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t.newNote}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </aside>
  );
};

===== FILE: note/src/components/NoteEditor.tsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ArrowDownAZ,
  ArrowLeft,
  CalendarClock,
  Check,
  CheckSquare,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Copy,
  Download,
  FilePlus2,
  Hash,
  Pin,
  Redo2,
  Replace,
  RotateCcw,
  Save,
  Search,
  SquareCheckBig,
  Trash2,
  Type,
  Undo2,
  WrapText,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLang, EditorFontFamily, EditorPrefs, NoteFolder, NoteItem } from '../types';
import { tLabel } from '../utils/i18n';
import {
  computeCursorStats,
  removeDuplicateLines,
  sortLinesAlphabetically,
  toTitleCase,
  trimTrailingSpaces,
} from '../utils/notesStore';

interface NoteEditorProps {
  lang: AppLang;
  note: NoteItem | null;
  prefs: EditorPrefs;
  isDirty: boolean;
  onUpdatePrefs: (patch: Partial<EditorPrefs>) => void;
  onChangeNote: (updated: NoteItem) => void;
  onSaveNow: () => void;
  onMoveToTrash: (id: string) => void;
  onRestoreNote: (id: string) => void;
  onDeleteForever: (id: string) => void;
  onDuplicateNote: (note: NoteItem) => void;
  onBackMobile: () => void;
  onCreateNew: () => void;
}

export const NoteEditor: React.FC<NoteEditorProps> = ({
  lang,
  note,
  prefs,
  isDirty,
  onUpdatePrefs,
  onChangeNote,
  onSaveNow,
  onMoveToTrash,
  onRestoreNote,
  onDeleteForever,
  onDuplicateNote,
  onBackMobile,
  onCreateNew,
}) => {
  const t = tLabel(lang);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>(null);
  const gutterRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const [cursorSel, setCursorSel] = useState<{ start: number; end: number }>({
    start: 0,
    end: 0,
  });
  const [undoStack, setUndoStack] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [redoStack, setRedoStack] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // PC Notepad bars
  const [findOpen, setFindOpen] = useState(false);
  const [findQuery, setFindQuery] = useState('');
  const [replaceQuery, setReplaceQuery] = useState('');
  const [matchCase, setMatchCase] = useState(false);
  const [activeMatchIdx, setActiveMatchIdx] = useState(0);

  const [goLineOpen, setGoLineOpen] = useState(false);
  const [goLineInput, setGoLineInput] = useState('');
  const [toolsMenuOpen, setToolsMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  // Reset undo/redo when switching notes
  useEffect(() => {
    setUndoStack([]);
    setRedoStack([]);
    setCursorSel({ start: 0, end: 0 });
  }, [note?.id]);

  // Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+G, Alt+Z, F5)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!note) return;
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 's') {
        e.preventDefault();
        onSaveNow();
      } else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'f') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setFindOpen(true);
      } else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'g') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setGoLineOpen(true);
      } else if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'z') {
        e.preventDefault();
        onUpdatePrefs({ wordWrap: !prefs.wordWrap });
      } else if (e.key === 'F5') {
        e.preventDefault();
        insertTimestamp();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  });

  const pushContentWithHistory = (nextContent: string) => {
    if (!note || nextContent === note.content) return;
    setUndoStack((s) => [...s.slice(-49), note.content]);
    setRedoStack([]);
    onChangeNote({
      ...note,
      content: nextContent,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });
  };

  const handleUndo = () => {
    if (!note || undoStack.length === 0) return;
    const prev = undoStack[undoStack.length - 1];
    setUndoStack((s) => s.slice(0, -1));
    setRedoStack((r) => [...r, note.content]);
    onChangeNote({ ...note, content: prev, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  };

  const handleRedo = () => {
    if (!note || redoStack.length === 0) return;
    const next = redoStack[redoStack.length - 1];
    setRedoStack((r) => r.slice(0, -1));
    setUndoStack((u) => [...u, note.content]);
    onChangeNote({ ...note, content: next, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  };

  const insertAtCursor = (snippet: string) => {
    if (!note) return;
    const el = textareaRef.current;
    const start = el ? el.selectionStart : note.content.length;
    const end = el ? el.selectionEnd : note.content.length;
    const next = note.content.slice(0, start) + snippet + note.content.slice(end);
    pushContentWithHistory(next);
    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (textareaRef.current) {
        const pos = start + snippet.length;
        textareaRef.current.focus();
        textareaRef.current.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);
        setCursorSel({ start: pos, end: pos });
      }
    });
  };

  const insertTimestamp = () => {
    const stamp = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
      lang === 'ar' ? 'ar-TN' : lang === 'fr' ? 'fr-TN' : 'en-GB',
      {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: '2-digit',
        day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      }
    ).format(new Date());
    insertAtCursor(stamp);
  };

  const insertCheckboxLine = () => {
    if (!note) return;
    const el = textareaRef.current;
    const start = el ? el.selectionStart : note.content.length;
    const needsNewline = start > 0 && note.content[start - 1] !== '\n';
    insertAtCursor(`${needsNewline ? '\n' : ''}[ ] `);
  };

  // Compute Find matches
  const matchIndices = useMemo(() => {
    if (!note || !findQuery) return [];
    const hay = matchCase ? note.content : note.content.toLowerCase();
    const needle = matchCase ? findQuery : findQuery.toLowerCase();
    const hits: number[] = [];
    let pos = 0;
    while (pos <= hay.length) {
      const idx = hay.indexOf(needle, pos);
      if (idx === -1) break;
      hits.push(idx);
      pos = idx + Math.max(1, needle.length);
    }
    return hits;
  }, [note?.content, findQuery, matchCase]);

  const jumpToMatch = (idxInHits: number) => {
    if (matchIndices.length === 0 || !textareaRef.current) return;
    const safeIdx =
      ((idxInHits % matchIndices.length) + matchIndices.length) % matchIndices.length;
    setActiveMatchIdx(safeIdx);
    const start = matchIndices[safeIdx];
    const end = start + findQuery.length;
    textareaRef.current.focus();
    textareaRef.current.setSelectionRange(start, end);
    setCursorSel({ start, end });
  };

  const handleReplaceCurrent = () => {
    if (!note || !findQuery || matchIndices.length === 0) return;
    const safeIdx = Math.min(activeMatchIdx, matchIndices.length - 1);
    const start = matchIndices[safeIdx];
    const next =
      note.content.slice(0, start) +
      replaceQuery +
      note.content.slice(start + findQuery.length);
    pushContentWithHistory(next);
  };

  const handleReplaceAll = () => {
    if (!note || !findQuery) return;
    const escaped = findQuery.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const regex = new RegExp(escaped, matchCase ? 'g' : 'gi');
    const next = note.content.replace(regex, replaceQuery);
    pushContentWithHistory(next);
  };

  const handleGoToLine = () => {
    if (!note || !textareaRef.current) return;
    const targetLine = Math.max(1, parseInt(goLineInput, 10) || 1);
    const lines = note.content.split('\n');
    const clamped = Math.min(lines.length, targetLine);
    let offset = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < clamped - 1; i++) {
      offset += lines[i].length + 1;
    }
    textareaRef.current.focus();
    textareaRef.current.setSelectionRange(offset, offset);
    setCursorSel({ start: offset, end: offset });
    setGoLineOpen(false);
  };

  const exportFile = (ext: 'txt' | 'md') => {
    if (!note) return;
    const safeTitle = (note.title.trim() || 'note').replace(/[^\w\-\u0600-\u06FF ]+/g, '_');
    const body =
      ext === 'md' && note.title.trim()
        ? `# ${note.title.trim()}\n\n${note.content}`
        : note.content;
    const blob = new Blob([body], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${safeTitle}.${ext}`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleCopyAll = async () => {
    if (!note) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(
        note.title.trim() ? `${note.title.trim()}\n\n${note.content}` : note.content
      );
      setCopied(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard fallback ignored
    }
  };

  const toggleChecklistLine = (lineIdx: number) => {
    if (!note) return;
    const lines = note.content.split('\n');
    const ln = lines[lineIdx];
    if (/^\s*\[ \]\s*/.test(ln)) {
      lines[lineIdx] = ln.replace('[ ]', '[x]');
    } else if (/^\s*\[x\]\s*/i.test(ln)) {
      lines[lineIdx] = ln.replace(/\[x\]/i, '[ ]');
    }
    pushContentWithHistory(lines.join('\n'));
  };

  if (!note) {
    return (
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-[#0a0a0a] p-6 text-center">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#d4af37]/30 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
          <FilePlus2 className="w-6 h-6 text-[#d4af37]" />
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#f4e095]">{t.emptyStateTitle}</h2>
        <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-400 mt-1 max-w-sm">{t.emptyStateDesc}</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCreateNew}
          className="mt-5 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#f4e095] via-[#d4af37] to-[#b58924] text-[#0a0a0a] font-extrabold text-sm hover:brightness-110 transition"
        >
          + {t.newNote}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const stats = computeCursorStats(note.content, cursorSel.start, cursorSel.end);
  const lineNumbersArray = Array.from({ length: stats.totalLines }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const isTrashed = note.deletedAt !== null;

  const fontClass =
    prefs.fontFamily === 'mono'
      ? 'font-mono'
      : prefs.fontFamily === 'serif'
      ? 'font-serif-note'
      : 'font-display';

  return (
    <div
      dir={lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
      className="flex flex-col flex-1 h-full min-w-0 bg-[#0a0a0a] overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Editor Top Action Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-[#101013] border-b border-zinc-800/80 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onBackMobile}
            className="md:hidden min-h-[38px] px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#16161b] border border-zinc-800 text-[#f4e095] text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t.back}</span>
          </button>

          <select
            value={note.folder}
            disabled={isTrashed}
            onChange={(e) =>
              onChangeNote({
                ...note,
                folder: e.target.value as Exclude<NoteFolder, 'all'>,
                updatedAt: Date.now(),
              })
            }
            className="bg-[#16161b] border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-[#f4e095] font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-[#d4af37]/45"
          >
            <option value="personal">{t.folderPersonal}</option>
            <option value="work">{t.folderWork}</option>
            <option value="ideas">{t.folderIdeas}</option>
            <option value="code">{t.folderCode}</option>
          </select>

          <span className="hidden sm:inline text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 px-1.5">
            {isDirty ? t.unsaved : t.saved}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          {!isTrashed ? (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onSaveNow}
                title={`${t.save} (Ctrl+S)`}
                className="min-h-[36px] px-3 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a] text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:brightness-110 transition"
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{t.save}</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  onChangeNote({ ...note, pinned: !note.pinned, updatedAt: Date.now() })
                }
                title={note.pinned ? t.unpin : t.pin}
                className={`min-w-[36px] min-h-[36px] rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-center transition ${
                  note.pinned
                    ? 'bg-[#d4af37]/20 border-[#d4af37]/50 text-[#f4e095]'
                    : 'bg-[#16161b] border-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#f4e095]'
                }`}
              >
                <Pin className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onMoveToTrash(note.id)}
                title={t.moveToTrash}
                className="min-w-[36px] min-h-[36px] rounded-lg bg-[#16161b] border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center transition"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onRestoreNote(note.id)}
                className="min-h-[36px] px-3 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a] text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{t.restore}</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onDeleteForever(note.id)}
                className="min-h-[36px] px-3 rounded-lg bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/40 text-red-300 text-xs font-bold"
              >
                {t.deleteForever}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Trash Banner */}
      {isTrashed && (
        <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-red-500/10 border-b border-red-500/25 text-xs text-red-300 shrink-0">
          {t.inTrashBanner}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* PC Notepad Secondary Formatting & File Toolbar */}
      <div className="relative flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#0e0e11] border-b border-zinc-800/70 overflow-x-auto shrink-0">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleUndo}
          disabled={undoStack.length === 0 || isTrashed}
          title={t.undo}
          className="p-2 rounded-lg text-zinc-300 hover:bg-[#1a1a20] disabled:opacity-35 shrink-0"
        >
          <Undo2 className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleRedo}
          disabled={redoStack.length === 0 || isTrashed}
          title={t.redo}
          className="p-2 rounded-lg text-zinc-300 hover:bg-[#1a1a20] disabled:opacity-35 shrink-0"
        >
          <Redo2 className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>

        <div className="w-px h-5 bg-zinc-800 mx-0.5 shrink-0" />

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onUpdatePrefs({ wordWrap: !prefs.wordWrap })}
          title={prefs.wordWrap ? t.wrapOn : t.wrapOff}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap transition shrink-0 ${
            prefs.wordWrap
              ? 'bg-[#d4af37]/20 text-[#f4e095] border border-[#d4af37]/40'
              : 'bg-[#16161b] text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-800'
          }`}
        >
          <WrapText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>{prefs.wordWrap ? t.wrapOn : t.wrapOff}</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onUpdatePrefs({ showLineNumbers: !prefs.showLineNumbers })}
          title={t.lines}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap transition shrink-0 ${
            prefs.showLineNumbers
              ? 'bg-[#d4af37]/20 text-[#f4e095] border border-[#d4af37]/40'
              : 'bg-[#16161b] text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-800'
          }`}
        >
          <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>{t.lines}</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFindOpen((o) => !o)}
          title={t.findReplace}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap transition shrink-0 ${
            findOpen
              ? 'bg-[#d4af37]/20 text-[#f4e095] border border-[#d4af37]/40'
              : 'bg-[#16161b] text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-800'
          }`}
        >
          <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">{t.findReplace}</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            onChangeNote({
              ...note,
              isChecklist: !note.isChecklist,
              updatedAt: Date.now(),
            })
          }
          title={t.checklist}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap transition shrink-0 ${
            note.isChecklist
              ? 'bg-[#d4af37]/20 text-[#f4e095] border border-[#d4af37]/40'
              : 'bg-[#16161b] text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-800'
          }`}
        >
          <SquareCheckBig className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>{t.checklist}</span>
        </button>

        {!isTrashed && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={insertCheckboxLine}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#16161b] border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap hover:text-[#f4e095] shrink-0"
          >
            <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#d4af37]" />
            <span>{t.addCheckbox}</span>
          </button>
        )}

        <select
          value={prefs.fontFamily}
          onChange={(e) =>
            onUpdatePrefs({ fontFamily: e.target.value as EditorFontFamily })
          }
          className="bg-[#16161b] border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none shrink-0"
        >
          <option value="sans">Sans (Outfit)</option>
          <option value="serif">Serif (Lora)</option>
          <option value="mono">Mono (Notepad)</option>
        </select>

        <div className="flex items-center bg-[#16161b] border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() =>
              onUpdatePrefs({ fontSize: Math.max(12, prefs.fontSize - 1) })
            }
            className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-[#f4e095]"
          >
            A-
          </button>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#d4af37] px-1">
            {prefs.fontSize}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() =>
              onUpdatePrefs({ fontSize: Math.min(26, prefs.fontSize + 1) })
            }
            className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-[#f4e095]"
          >
            A+
          </button>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setToolsMenuOpen((o) => !o)}
          className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#16161b] border border-[#d4af37]/30 text-[#f4e095] text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
        >
          <Type className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>{t.tools}</span>
          <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* PC Notepad Tools Popover Drawer */}
      {toolsMenuOpen && (
        <div className="px-3 py-2.5 bg-[#121216] border-b border-[#d4af37]/25 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              insertTimestamp();
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40 flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <CalendarClock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#d4af37]" />
            {t.timestamp} (F5)
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setGoLineOpen(true);
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40"
          >
            {t.goToLine} (Ctrl+G)
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              pushContentWithHistory(note.content.toUpperCase());
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40"
          >
            {t.upperCase}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              pushContentWithHistory(note.content.toLowerCase());
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40"
          >
            {t.lowerCase}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              pushContentWithHistory(toTitleCase(note.content));
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40"
          >
            {t.titleCase}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              pushContentWithHistory(sortLinesAlphabetically(note.content));
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40 flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <ArrowDownAZ className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#d4af37]" />
            {t.sortLines}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              pushContentWithHistory(removeDuplicateLines(note.content));
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40"
          >
            {t.dedupeLines}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              pushContentWithHistory(trimTrailingSpaces(note.content));
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40"
          >
            {t.trimSpaces}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              void handleCopyAll();
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40 flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            {copied ? (
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            ) : (
              <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#d4af37]" />
            )}
            {copied ? t.copied : t.copyAll}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onDuplicateNote(note);
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-[#d4af37]/40"
          >
            {t.duplicateNote}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              exportFile('txt');
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37]/15 border border-[#d4af37]/35 text-xs font-bold text-[#f4e095] flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            {t.exportTxt}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              exportFile('md');
              setToolsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37]/15 border border-[#d4af37]/35 text-xs font-bold text-[#f4e095] flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            {t.exportMd}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Find & Replace Drawer */}
      {findOpen && (
        <div className="px-3 py-2.5 bg-[#121216] border-b border-[#d4af37]/30 space-y-2 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={findQuery}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setFindQuery(e.target.value);
                setActiveMatchIdx(0);
              }}
              placeholder={t.findPlaceholder}
              className="flex-1 min-w-[140px] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0b0b0e] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#d4af37]/50"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMatchCase((m) => !m)}
              className={`px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold border ${
                matchCase
                  ? 'bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a] border-[#f4e095]'
                  : 'bg-[#18181f] text-zinc-400 border-zinc-800'
              }`}
            >
              {t.matchCase}
            </button>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 min-w-[46px] text-center">
              {matchIndices.length > 0
                ? `${(activeMatchIdx % matchIndices.length) + 1}/${matchIndices.length}`
                : '0/0'}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => jumpToMatch(activeMatchIdx - 1)}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300"
            >
              <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => jumpToMatch(activeMatchIdx + 1)}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300"
            >
              <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFindOpen(false)}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={replaceQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setReplaceQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t.replacePlaceholder}
              className="flex-1 min-w-[140px] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0b0b0e] border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#d4af37]/50"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={!findQuery || matchIndices.length === 0}
              onClick={handleReplaceCurrent}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#18181f] border border-zinc-800 text-xs font-bold text-[#f4e095] disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Replace className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              {t.replaceOne}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={!findQuery || matchIndices.length === 0}
              onClick={handleReplaceAll}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a] text-xs font-extrabold disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {t.replaceAll}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Go To Line Drawer */}
      {goLineOpen && (
        <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-[#121216] border-b border-[#d4af37]/30 flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-300">{t.lineNumberPrompt}:</span>
          <input
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={stats.totalLines}
            value={goLineInput}
            onChange={(e) => setGoLineInput(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') handleGoToLine();
            }}
            className="w-24 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#0b0b0e] border border-zinc-800 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#d4af37]/50"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleGoToLine}
            className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a] text-xs font-extrabold"
          >
            {t.go}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setGoLineOpen(false)}
            className="p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white ml-auto"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Title Input */}
      <div className="px-4 pt-4 pb-2 border-b border-zinc-900 shrink-0">
        <input
          type="text"
          readOnly={isTrashed}
          value={note.title}
          onChange={(e) =>
            onChangeNote({
              ...note,
              title: e.target.value,
              updatedAt: Date.now(),
            })
          }
          placeholder={t.titlePlaceholder}
          className="w-full bg-transparent text-xl sm:text-2xl font-extrabold text-[#f4e095] placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:outline-none font-display"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Checklist Panel (when Checklist mode enabled and note contains [ ] / [x] items) */}
      {note.isChecklist && (
        <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-[#0f0f13] border-b border-zinc-800/80 space-y-1.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto shrink-0">
          {note.content.split('\n').map((ln, idx) => {
            const isUnchecked = /^\s*\[ \]\s*/.test(ln);
            const isChecked = /^\s*\[x\]\s*/i.test(ln);
            if (!isUnchecked && !isChecked) return null;
            const cleanText = ln.replace(/^\s*\[( |x)\]\s*/i, '');
            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                type="button"
                disabled={isTrashed}
                onClick={() => toggleChecklistLine(idx)}
                className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 text-left py-1 text-sm hover:bg-white/[0.03] rounded-lg px-1.5 transition"
              >
                <span
                  className={`w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                    isChecked
                      ? 'bg-[#d4af37] border-[#d4af37] text-[#0a0a0a]'
                      : 'border-[#d4af37]/50 bg-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isChecked && <Check className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[3]" />}
                </span>
                <span className={isChecked ? 'line-through text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-200'}>
                  {cleanText || 'Task'}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Editor Body with Optional Line Numbers Gutter + Word Wrap Toggle */}
      <div className="flex flex-1 min-h-0 relative overflow-hidden">
        {prefs.showLineNumbers && (
          <div
            ref={gutterRef}
            aria-hidden="true"
            style={{ fontSize: `${prefs.fontSize}px`, lineHeight: 1.65 }}
            className="w-12 py-4 px-2 bg-[#0c0c0f] border-r border-zinc-900 text-right font-mono text-zinc-600 select-none overflow-hidden shrink-0"
          >
            {lineNumbersArray.map((num) => (
              <div
                key={num}
                className={num === stats.line ? 'text-[#d4af37] font-bold' : ''}
              >
                {num}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <textarea
          ref={textareaRef}
          readOnly={isTrashed}
          value={note.content}
          wrap={prefs.wordWrap ? 'soft' : 'off'}
          onChange={(e) => {
            pushContentWithHistory(e.target.value);
            setCursorSel({
              start: e.target.selectionStart,
              end: e.target.selectionEnd,
            });
          }}
          onScroll={(e) => {
            if (gutterRef.current) {
              gutterRef.current.scrollTop = e.currentTarget.scrollTop;
            }
          }}
          onSelect={(e) => {
            setCursorSel({
              start: e.currentTarget.selectionStart,
              end: e.currentTarget.selectionEnd,
            });
          }}
          onKeyUp={(e) => {
            setCursorSel({
              start: e.currentTarget.selectionStart,
              end: e.currentTarget.selectionEnd,
            });
          }}
          placeholder={t.contentPlaceholder}
          style={{ fontSize: `${prefs.fontSize}px`, lineHeight: 1.65 }}
          className={`flex-1 w-full h-full p-4 bg-transparent text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:outline-none resize-none ${fontClass} ${
            prefs.wordWrap
              ? 'whitespace-pre-wrap break-words overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden'
              : 'whitespace-pre overflow-auto'
          }`}
        />
      </div>

      {/* PC Notepad Status Bar (clean unboxed tabular numerals) */}
      <footer className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-1.5 bg-[#0e0e11] border-t border-zinc-800/80 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className="text-[#f4e095]">
            Ln {stats.line}, Col {stats.column}
          </span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
          <span>
            {stats.words} {t.words}
          </span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
          <span>
            {stats.chars} {t.chars}
          </span>
          {stats.selectedChars > 0 && (
            <>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span className="text-[#d4af37]">
                {stats.selectedChars} {t.selected}
              </span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span>{prefs.wordWrap ? 'Wrap' : 'No-Wrap'}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
          <span>UTF-8</span>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
};

===== FILE: note/src/utils/usePWAInstall.ts =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

interface BeforeInstallPromptEvent extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
  userChoice: Promise<{ outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed'; platform: string }>;
}

export function usePWAInstall() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState<BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null>(null);
  const [isInstalled, setIsInstalled] = useState(false);
  const [isIOS, setIsIOS] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isStandalone =
      window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
      (window.navigator as unknown as { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true;
    setIsInstalled(isStandalone);

    const ua = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    setIsIOS(/iphone|ipad|ipod/.test(ua));

    const onBeforeInstall = (e: Event) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(e as BeforeInstallPromptEvent);
    };
    const onInstalled = () => {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onBeforeInstall);
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', onInstalled);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onBeforeInstall);
      window.removeEventListener('appinstalled', onInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  const install = async () => {
    if (!deferredPrompt) return false;
    await deferredPrompt.prompt();
    const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
    if (outcome === 'accepted') {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  return {
    isInstallable: Boolean(deferredPrompt),
    isInstalled,
    isIOS,
    install,
  };
}

===== FILE: note/src/utils/notesStore.ts =====
import { EditorPrefs, NoteFolder, NoteItem } from '../types';

const DB_NAME = 'NotesGoldDB';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NOTES = 'notes';
const PREFS_KEY = 'notes_gold_prefs_v1';
const SEEDED_KEY = 'notes_gold_seeded_v1';

export const DEFAULT_PREFS: EditorPrefs = {
  wordWrap: true,
  showLineNumbers: true,
  fontFamily: 'sans',
  fontSize: 15,
  layoutMode: 'list',
  sortMode: 'updated',
};

function openNotesDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NOTES)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NOTES, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

function createInitialNotes(): NoteItem[] {
  const now = Date.now();
  return [
    {
      id: `note_welcome_${now}`,
      title: 'Welcome to Notes Gold',
      content:
        'Notes Gold combines Samsung/Xiaomi Notes comfort with PC Notepad tools.\n\n[ ] Tap "Save" or press Ctrl+S anytime\n[ ] Toggle Word Wrap to wrap long lines or scroll horizontally\n[ ] Show Line Numbers (#) & check Ln / Col status below\n[ ] Use Find & Replace (Ctrl+F) or Go To Line (Ctrl+G)\n[ ] Open or Export .TXT / .MD files directly',
      folder: 'personal',
      pinned: true,
      isChecklist: true,
      createdAt: now - 3600000,
      updatedAt: now - 120000,
      deletedAt: null,
    },
    {
      id: `note_notepad_${now + 1}`,
      title: 'PC Notepad Quick Reference',
      content:
        'Line 01: Kasserine City, Tunisia — Offline-ready workspace\nLine 02: Sort lines alphabetically A-Z or remove duplicate lines\nLine 03: Convert selection or text to UPPERCASE / lowercase / Title Case\nLine 04: Press F5 or tap Timestamp to insert Date & Time\nLine 05: Switch font between Sans, Lora Serif, and JetBrains Mono',
      folder: 'code',
      pinned: false,
      isChecklist: false,
      createdAt: now - 7200000,
      updatedAt: now - 2400000,
      deletedAt: null,
    },
  ];
}

export async function loadAllNotes(): Promise<NoteItem[]> {
  try {
    const db = await openNotesDb();
    const rows = await new Promise<NoteItem[]>((resolve) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NOTES, 'readonly');
      const req = tx.objectStore(STORE_NOTES).getAll();
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve((req.result as NoteItem[]) || []);
      req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
    });

    if (rows.length === 0 && !localStorage.getItem(SEEDED_KEY)) {
      const starter = createInitialNotes();
      localStorage.setItem(SEEDED_KEY, '1');
      for (const n of starter) {
        await saveNoteRecord(n);
      }
      return starter;
    }
    return rows;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function saveNoteRecord(note: NoteItem): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openNotesDb();
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NOTES, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE_NOTES).put(note);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

export async function deleteNoteRecordForever(id: string): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openNotesDb();
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NOTES, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE_NOTES).delete(id);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

export async function emptyTrashRecords(): Promise<void> {
  const all = await loadAllNotes();
  const trashed = all.filter((n) => n.deletedAt !== null);
  for (const item of trashed) {
    await deleteNoteRecordForever(item.id);
  }
}

export function createBlankNote(folder: Exclude<NoteFolder, 'all'> = 'personal'): NoteItem {
  const now = Date.now();
  return {
    id: `note_${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    title: '',
    content: '',
    folder,
    pinned: false,
    isChecklist: false,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    deletedAt: null,
  };
}

export function loadEditorPrefs(): EditorPrefs {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PREFS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return DEFAULT_PREFS;
    return { ...DEFAULT_PREFS, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_PREFS;
  }
}

export function saveEditorPrefs(prefs: EditorPrefs): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PREFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(prefs));
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage quota errors
  }
}

export function computeCursorStats(text: string, selectionStart: number, selectionEnd: number) {
  const safeStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(text.length, selectionStart));
  const before = text.slice(0, safeStart);
  const lines = before.split('\n');
  const line = lines.length;
  const column = lines[lines.length - 1].length + 1;
  const words = text.trim() ? text.trim().split(/\s+/).length : 0;
  const totalLines = text.split('\n').length;
  const selectedChars = Math.max(0, selectionEnd - selectionStart);
  return { line, column, words, chars: text.length, totalLines, selectedChars };
}

export function sortLinesAlphabetically(text: string): string {
  return text
    .split('\n')
    .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .join('\n');
}

export function removeDuplicateLines(text: string): string {
  const seen: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  const result: string[] = [];
  for (const ln of text.split('\n')) {
    if (!seen[ln]) {
      seen[ln] = true;
      result.push(ln);
    }
  }
  return result.join('\n');
}

export function trimTrailingSpaces(text: string): string {
  return text
    .split('\n')
    .map((ln) => ln.replace(/[ \t]+$/g, ''))
    .join('\n');
}

export function toTitleCase(text: string): string {
  return text.replace(/\b\w+/g, (w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase());
}

// If the loader is already loaded, just stop.
if (!self.define) {
  let registry = {};

  // Used for `eval` and `importScripts` where we can't get script URL by other means.
  // In both cases, it's safe to use a global var because those functions are synchronous.
  let nextDefineUri;

  const singleRequire = (uri, parentUri) => {
    uri = new URL(uri + ".js", parentUri).href;
    return registry[uri] || (
      
        new Promise(resolve => {
          if ("document" in self) {
            const script = document.createElement("script");
            script.src = uri;
            script.onload = resolve;
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          } else {
            nextDefineUri = uri;
            importScripts(uri);
            resolve();
          }
        })
      
      .then(() => {
        let promise = registry[uri];
        if (!promise) {
          throw new Error(`Module ${uri} didn’t register its module`);
        }
        return promise;
      })
    );
  };

  self.define = (depsNames, factory) => {
    const uri = nextDefineUri || ("document" in self ? document.currentScript.src : "") || location.href;
    if (registry[uri]) {
      // Module is already loading or loaded.
      return;
    }
    let exports = {};
    const require = depUri => singleRequire(depUri, uri);
    const specialDeps = {
      module: { uri },
      exports,
      require
    };
    registry[uri] = Promise.all(depsNames.map(
      depName => specialDeps[depName] || require(depName)
    )).then(deps => {
      factory(...deps);
      return exports;
    });
  };
}

    /**
     * Workbox errors should be thrown with this class.
     * This allows use to ensure the type easily in tests,
     * helps developers identify errors from workbox
     * easily and allows use to optimise error
     * messages correctly.
     *
     * @private
     */
    class WorkboxError extends Error {
      /**
       *
       * @param {string} errorCode The error code that
       * identifies this particular error.
       * @param {Object=} details Any relevant arguments
       * that will help developers identify issues should
       * be added as a key on the context object.
       */
      constructor(errorCode, details) {
        const message = messageGenerator(errorCode, details);
        super(message);
        this.name = errorCode;
        this.details = details;
      }
    }

    /*
     * This method throws if the supplied value is not an array.
     * The destructed values are required to produce a meaningful error for users.
     * The destructed and restructured object is so it's clear what is
     * needed.
     */
    const isArray = (value, details) => {
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
        throw new WorkboxError('not-an-array', details);
      }
    };
    const hasMethod = (object, expectedMethod, details) => {
      const type = typeof object[expectedMethod];
      if (type !== 'function') {
        details['expectedMethod'] = expectedMethod;
        throw new WorkboxError('missing-a-method', details);
      }
    };
    const isType = (object, expectedType, details) => {
      if (typeof object !== expectedType) {
        details['expectedType'] = expectedType;
        throw new WorkboxError('incorrect-type', details);
      }
    };
    const isInstance = (object,
    // Need the general type to do the check later.
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-types
    expectedClass, details) => {
      if (!(object instanceof expectedClass)) {
        details['expectedClassName'] = expectedClass.name;
        throw new WorkboxError('incorrect-class', details);
      }
    };
    const isOneOf = (value, validValues, details) => {
      if (!validValues.includes(value)) {
        details['validValueDescription'] = `Valid values are ${JSON.stringify(validValues)}.`;
        throw new WorkboxError('invalid-value', details);
      }
    };
    const isArrayOfClass = (value,
    // Need general type to do check later.
    expectedClass,
    // eslint-disable-line
    details) => {
      const error = new WorkboxError('not-array-of-class', details);
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
        throw error;
      }
      for (const item of value) {
        if (!(item instanceof expectedClass)) {
          throw error;
        }
      }
    };
    const finalAssertExports = {
      hasMethod,
      isArray,
      isInstance,
      isOneOf,
      isType,
      isArrayOfClass

    /**
     * @param {function()|Object} handler Either a function, or an object with a
     * 'handle' method.
     * @return {Object} An object with a handle method.
     *
     * @private
     */
    const normalizeHandler = handler => {
      if (handler && typeof handler === 'object') {
        {
          finalAssertExports.hasMethod(handler, 'handle', {
            moduleName: 'workbox-routing',
            className: 'Route',
            funcName: 'constructor',
            paramName: 'handler'
          });
        }
        return handler;
      } else {
        {
          finalAssertExports.isType(handler, 'function', {
            moduleName: 'workbox-routing',
            className: 'Route',
            funcName: 'constructor',
            paramName: 'handler'
          });
        }
        return {
          handle: handler
        };
      }
    };
